design_philosophy.vibe: Command-center focus. High contrast, athletic, professional.

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-bold (600/700). Use for Page Titles and KPI values.
usage_rules.body: Regular (400) or Medium (500). High legibility. Use for lists and form labels.
usage_rules.overline: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, font-medium. Use for section labels.

primary.name: Emerald Bet
primary.usage: Primary Actions (Save, Start, Confirm), Success States

gradients.hero_glow: radial-gradient(circle at top center, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15) 0%, rgba(2, 6, 23, 0) 70%)

mobile_first_strategy.navigation: Bottom Tab Bar (Fixed) for Mobile. Sidebar for Desktop.
mobile_first_strategy.containers: Full width on mobile with p-4 padding. Max-width-5xl centered on desktop.
mobile_first_strategy.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for all interactive elements.

buttons.style: Sharp corners (rounded-sm) or Pill (rounded-full). High contrast.

cards.style: Grid Border Style. 1px border (border-slate-800). No shadow in dark mode. Subtle shadow in light mode.
cards.interaction: Active border color change on hover.

inputs.style: h-12 bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent

navigation.bottom_bar: Fixed bottom, backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-t border-border. Icons + Labels (text-[10px]).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders with 10% opacity for structure.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Glow effects for primary actions: shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)].

login_background.desc: Moody betting hall / bowling alley with LED lights. Use with heavy dark overlay.

training_hero.desc: Team workshop setting. Use for 'Training' section headers.

manager_profile.desc: Professional manager at desk. Placeholder for user profile.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the 'Performance Pro' theme immediately. Set body background to dark (#020617) by default.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all headings (h1-h6) and KPI numbers. Use 'Inter' for everything else.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build the 'Bottom Navigation' component first. It is the core of the mobile experience.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: For the Dashboard: Use a 'Bento Grid' layout. Top card: 'My Progress'. Middle: 'Upcoming Training'. Bottom: 'Quick Stats'.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Forms: Use Shadcn Form + React Hook Form. Ensure inputs are 48px height (h-12) for touch accessibility.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Charts) with the defined palette (Emerald, Slate, Amber).
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Login Page: Use the 'login_background' image with a heavy black gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-background to-transparent).
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids and asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays/modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (pill or sharp).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
